description: This file defines the CatalogUrlServlet class, a Java servlet responsible for handling HTTP requests related to product and category URL routing within an e-commerce web application based on the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages URL parsing, trail building for categories, and URL generation for product/category pages.

classes.name: CatalogUrlServlet
classes.description: A servlet that routes product and category URLs, constructs trail data, and forwards requests to appropriate views within the OFBiz application.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Delegates POST requests to the doGet method for uniform handling.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Processes incoming GET requests, parses URL path info to identify product or category IDs, sets request attributes accordingly, manages category trail data, and forwards to the correct view.

methods.name: makeCatalogUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL pointing to a product or category page based on the current request, trail, and provided IDs, for client-side linking.

methods.name: makeCatalogUrl (overloaded)
methods.description: Builds a catalog URL given the context path, breadcrumb list, and IDs, used for generating URLs outside of a request context.
